prompts.oak:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent production sprite for the hand-drawn cartoon fantasy game 深渊行者.
The reference image is the USER-APPROVED camp-unified-v2 art direction. Match its softly outlined, rounded, broad hand-painted forms, clean 2-3 value shading, restrained warm highlights and midtone moss/cobalt/wood palette.
Keep the reference's orthographic isometric view: ground axes have slopes +/-18/32, camera elevated about 30 degrees, no perspective convergence. Light comes from upper left. An isolated complete object only; no UI, letters, labels, extra scenery, decorative base plate, watermark or cast ground shadow. Actual transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard. Fine material details sparse, clear silhouette readable when displayed 150-300px high, not photorealistic or glossy 3D. Center with 8% transparent safety margin.
Subject: one sturdy rounded fantasy oak as in the lower-left of the camp reference, with a stout curved brown trunk, 5-7 large moss-green and muted teal leaf clusters, a few warm light leaf shapes, modest visible roots. A few broad canopy shadow shapes, no hundreds of tiny leaves or flowers. Complete standalone tree, no surrounding rocks or grass patch.

prompts.grass:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production repeatable terrain texture, flat orthographic TOP DOWN. Use the approved reference only for style and grass palette.
Produce a genuinely seamless square grass-ground texture, edges match on both horizontal and vertical repeat. Midtone muted moss/sage green hand-painted broad irregular color patches with only sparse softly shaped blades, subdued blue-green shadow clusters. Very low spatial detail and contrast; large clean playable green areas dominate. No bright yellow flecks, tiny busy leaves, flowers, isolated object, stone, path, perspective, horizon, directional vignette, text or border. Uniform daylight, no large cast shadows. Entire opaque canvas filled with grass. This bitmap will be isometrically projected by the engine, do not pre-project it.
